subject: Order still not here
body: Ordered a kurta set from StitchNest on 12 Oct and it hasn't even shipped yet. Three weeks of 'processing' is a joke. Meera

subject: Re: Re: Water leaking from ceiling, Flat 4B
body: Dear Mr. Fernandes, this is my third email about the leak in my bedroom ceiling and I have yet to receive even an acknowledgement. I have also phoned the Harbourview Residences office twice and was told someone would call back. Nobody did. Mould is now forming on the wall and my toddler sleeps in that room. If I don't hear from a manager by Friday I will approach the housing society and the local authority. Regards, Ananya Bhatt

subject: Treatment of parents at the admissions desk
body: I hope this email finds you well, but I am writing because my visit to the front office of Greenfield Valley School on Monday was a poor one. The clerk barely looked up, spoke to me in a dismissive tone and told me to come back tomorrow without any explanation. I took leave from work for this and was treated like a nuisance. I expect better from an institution that talks so much about values. Suresh Iyer

subject: Driver was extremely rude
body: Your driver on trip RX-48213 shouted at me for asking him to switch the AC on. Not acceptable. - Priyanka

subject: URGENT: Fourth outage this month and nobody fixes the root cause
body: To the Customer Experience Head, my fibre connection with SwiftLink Broadband (account SL-7720194) has dropped four times since 3 October, each time for 6 to 18 hours. Every time I call, an agent promises a technician within 24 hours and then hands me a new ticket number instead: 55102, 55377, 55841 and now 56019. A technician finally came on 14 October, spent ten minutes, said everything was fine and left, and the line died again that night. I work from home and have already lost two client days, so the outage itself is only half of my frustration; the casual way I am being handled is the other half. I am also being told that this month's bill will be the full Rs. 1,299 with no adjustment. I want a senior person to take ownership of this, not another scripted apology. If it is not sorted by the 30th I will move to another provider and say why publicly. Karthik Raghavan

subject: Technician never showed up
body: Hello, I booked a geyser repair with FixItFast for Saturday between 10 and 12 and sat at home the entire day. No technician came, no call, no message. When I rang the helpline at 4 pm the girl said she could not see any record of my booking even though I have the confirmation SMS. Please explain how this is supposed to work. Vikram Nair

subject: Waiting 5 weeks for a new meter
body: I applied for a new electricity connection with Bharat Power Distribution on 18 September (application no. NC/22/09/4471). Four different people at the divisional office have told me 'next week'. My house has been ready since August and I am running a generator that costs me about Rs. 900 a day. Someone needs to explain why a simple connection takes this long. Lakshmi Devi

subject: Ad vs reality
body: Hi, the 'ultra-light' backpack I got from TrekMate Store weighs nearly 1.4 kg, not the 600 g shown on the listing. Just feedback, you may want to correct the page.

subject: Unsafe driving on my trip last night
body: Last Wednesday evening I took a ride with Zipp Cabs from Guindy to T. Nagar and the driver was speeding, jumped a red light and kept checking his phone. When I asked him to slow down he laughed it off. I got off before reaching my destination because I genuinely felt unsafe. This could have ended badly for a woman travelling alone. I want someone from your safety team to look at the trip details and call me. Divya Menon

subject: Hygiene in the canteen at Riverdale Public School
body: Dear Principal, I am writing about the school canteen, where my daughter in Class 6 found a hair in her lunch twice this month, on 7 October and again on 19 October. On the second day she also saw a cockroach near the serving counter and refused to eat anything for the rest of the day. I raised this with the canteen supervisor, who said the children exaggerate and walked off. The washing area behind the counter was visibly dirty when I visited on the 20th, with stagnant water and uncovered bins. Several other parents in the class WhatsApp group are reporting stomach upsets this week. I understand the canteen is outsourced, but the responsibility for keeping children safe remains with the school. I request an immediate inspection and a written response. If there is no action I will approach the education officer and the district food safety office. Yours sincerely, Rajeshwari Narayanan (parent of Anika, 6-C)

subject: Flat was not as advertised
body: Hi, we moved into a unit at Palm Terrace Residences based on a listing that promised a modular kitchen, covered parking and 24-hour water. It has none of these, and the agent now says those were 'optional add-ons'. That was not what the brochure or the photos suggested. We feel misled and would like a senior person from your leasing team to speak to us. Mohammed Al-Rashid

subject: Unlimited plan is not unlimited
body: Your advert for the Blaze 599 plan says unlimited data, yet my speed collapses after 200 GB and I was told it is a 'fair usage policy' that nobody mentioned at signup. The fine print sits at the very bottom of a page. I have also been charged Rs. 118 extra this month for a reason no one can explain. Mainly I want to say that this advertising feels deceptive. Emily Carter, account 88341-B

subject: AC repaired three times, still not cooling
body: Writing about the split AC I got serviced through CoolCare Home Services. The first visit was on 2 September (job 90114), when the technician topped up the gas and charged Rs. 2,400. It stopped cooling after four days, so he came again on the 11th and said the capacitor was changed. Two weeks later it started leaking and making a grinding noise, and a third visit on 3 October was supposed to settle things. It is now the 25th, the unit is warm again, and your call centre keeps telling me a supervisor will phone me. No supervisor has phoned. I have wasted three mornings at home for a machine that still does not work. Please stop sending the same junior technician and put someone who knows what they are doing on this. Gurpreet Singh

subject: no callback for 3 days
body: nobody from CityGas has called me back since monday even tho they said within 24 hrs. no gas supply in my building since the 20th and kids eating out every day

subject: your chat support is a joke
body: so i spent 50 mins on live chat with ShopSphere yesterday and the agent kept pasting the same canned lines, then closed the chat when i asked for his manager. who trains these people?? i just wanted someone to actually read my message. Arjun

subject: Security guard behaviour
body: The guard at the main gate of Orchid Heights was abusive to my visiting mother yesterday and refused her entry for no reason. Please address this. Sunita Rao

subject: Re: Re: Meeting request with class teacher
body: Good morning, I have sent two emails and left one voicemail with the administration at Lakeside International Academy asking for a meeting with Ms. Daniels about my son's grades. It has been 12 days and nobody has even acknowledged them. When I phoned the office, the receptionist said she would 'pass on the message'. I don't think she did. A school that cannot answer a parent's basic email is a concern in itself. Thomas Becker

subject: 45 min wait!!
body: waited 45 mins for the cab to come then driver cancelled. second time this week. cant keep doing this

subject: Considering switching
body: Honestly I'm done with Orbit Net. Slow support, nothing ever gets fixed, will port out if nothing changes this week.

subject: Screen repair was botched
body: Hi, I gave my phone to GadgetDoc in Velachery for a screen replacement on 9 Oct and paid Rs. 3,800. The new screen has a visible yellow patch and the touch is laggy, and when I went back the staff said it was 'normal for this type of panel' and refused to look at it again. I want to put on record how unprofessional this was. I would like a refund at the very least, but mainly I want someone to answer for the attitude. Imran Sheikh

subject: URGENT: Brown, smelly water supply in Sector 12
body: To whom it may concern, since 14 October the municipal supply to our building in Sector 12 has been coming out brown with a strong smell. Around 30 residents, including several elderly people and infants, depend on it for drinking and cooking. Two neighbours have been treated for stomach infections this week. We reported the matter on your helpline on the 15th (reference MW-2210983) and again on the 18th, and the answer each time has been that a team will inspect. No team has visited. A junior officer suggested we simply buy bottled water in the meantime. This is a public health matter, not a minor inconvenience, and it needs somebody senior to act now. If I don't get an answer within 48 hours I will contact the local newspaper and the health department. Pradeep Kulkarni, Secretary, Sunrise Apartments Residents Association

subject: Damaged and late, and no one cares
body: Order #ES-340918 for a Rs. 6,499 mixer grinder reached me eleven days after the promised date with a dented jar and the box open at one end. When I phoned, the agent was curt and told me to 'upload photos and wait'. Fine, I did, but I want a proper apology and a manager who knows what has happened. I'll be asking for a replacement or my money back, but for now I'm mostly upset at how I was handled. Farah Khan

subject: School bus coming late every day
body: Dear Transport In-charge, bus no. 14 of Vidya Mandir Matric School has arrived 30 to 50 minutes late nearly every morning this month, so my daughter keeps missing assembly and her first period. We have raised this with the driver and with the office, and each points at the other. Please tell us who is responsible and what will be done. Thank you, Mrs. Kavitha Subramanian

subject: Escalation to management: unresolved issues at Sunview Towers
body: Dear Mr. Joshi, I am writing directly to you because the property manager at Sunview Towers, Mr. Dsouza, has not responded to anything I have raised over the last two months. On 2 September I reported a broken intercom, on 20 September a damaged letterbox lock, and on 6 October a blocked drain on the parking level that now floods whenever it rains. He told me over the phone that I was 'too picky' and that tenants pay Rs. 4,500 a month in maintenance for 'basic things only'. I find that tone unacceptable, and I have noticed he says the same to other residents. I have been a tenant for three years, always paid on time, and am being treated like a troublemaker. Please step in personally and have someone call me by Wednesday. If nothing changes I will look at ending my lease at the next renewal and share my experience in the residents' forum and online reviews. Neha Kapoor, Flat 1203

subject: Fifth cancellation in a week, well done
body: Congratulations to Voyago on cancelling my ride five times in seven days. Truly an exceptional service. I now plan my commute around the likelihood that nobody will pick me up, which seems to be your business model. Please fix it or stop calling it a service. Ritika

subject: Installation appointment missed twice
body: Booked a broadband installation with Zenith Fibre for 15 October and the engineer did not arrive. The reschedule on the 19th ended exactly the same way, and the call centre said the slot 'got cancelled by system'. I have taken half a day off twice. Is anyone planning to actually show up? Ibrahim Yusuf

subject: Mess left behind
body: technician from HomeFix left oil stains all over my kitchen floor and muddy footprints on the carpet after fixing the chimney, didnt even say sorry

subject: URGENT: Gas smell, no proper response
body: There has been a smell of gas near the meter outside our building since this morning and I reported it to the emergency line of Capital Gas twice. The first time I was kept on hold for 25 minutes and then disconnected, and the second time the operator simply gave me a ticket number and said the team was busy. A gas leak should never be treated this way. Please call me back right now. Anil Deshmukh

subject: Fake 70% off sale, I have screenshots
body: On 11 October I bought a pair of running shoes from the TrackLine online store during what the banner called a Mega Sale with up to 70 percent off. The page showed a crossed-out price of Rs. 7,999 and a sale price of Rs. 2,399, order ref TL-2210-8841. After buying I realised the same shoes had been listed at Rs. 2,799 a week earlier, because I had saved that page. So the original price shown was invented to make the discount look bigger. I contacted your support on the 14th and got a reply saying the discount is 'as per policy', with no explanation. I feel misled, and I am sure I am not the only one. I would like a senior representative to respond in writing, otherwise I will take this to the consumer forum and post the screenshots. Aditya Verma

subject: Hostel food feedback
body: Sir, the hostel mess at Cedar Grove College has served the same dry chapati and watery dal for two weeks, kindly look into the quality sometime. - Hari (2nd year)

subject: Lift out of order again, 6th time since August
body: Hello, this is regarding the lift in Block C of Lotus Garden Apartments, which has broken down for the sixth time since August. On 9 October it was stuck between floors with my 74-year-old father inside for nearly 20 minutes before security finally got him out. I live on the 11th floor and elderly residents here simply cannot climb. Every time I visit the maintenance office I am told the vendor has been informed, and that is all anyone can say. The notice board still carries an 'under repair' sign dated 27 September. We pay Rs. 3,200 monthly in maintenance charges and have nothing to show for it. I would like a clear written timeline and the name of someone who will be accountable, since I am done with verbal assurances. Kiran Patel

subject: Small feedback on last ride
body: Just a note: the driver was fine but the car smelled of smoke and the seat was sticky. Maybe worth a quick check on vehicle cleanliness. Thanks, Alex

subject: Support line waiting time
body: Hi team, I waited about 20 minutes on your support line yesterday before an agent picked up. Once connected the agent was polite and helpful, but the wait was a bit much. It might be worth adding more staff in the evenings. Regards, Nandini

subject: Third email: laptop still with you
body: This is my third email about my laptop, at your service centre since 29 September, and nobody replies. Return it today or I go to the consumer court. - Rohit S.

subject: water meter inspector never came
body: Someone from the water utility was supposed to come for a meter inspection on Tuesday between 9 and 1. No one came and there was no call either. Thats the second time and I am loosing a day of work every time. Please send somebody who actually follows the schedule. Bhavna Shah

subject: No reply from seller for 10 days
body: hi, i bought a bluetooth speaker from your marketplace on 5th oct (order 4471-9920) and it came with no charger. messaged the seller 6 times, no reply at all and your help page just loops. i dont understand how a company can ignore its customers like this. at least send me the charger or give a refund but honestly more annoyed at the silence. Zoya

subject: Behaviour of class teacher towards my son, Class 4
body: Dear Madam, I need to bring to your attention an incident involving my son Aarav, Class 4-B, at St. Joseph's Day School. On 16 October his class teacher Mrs. Pillai made him stand outside the classroom for the entire period and called him 'useless' in front of the other children because he forgot his workbook. He came home distressed, did not eat, and told me he does not want to go to school anymore. When I called the school office the next day, the receptionist said the teacher was 'senior' and that I should 'adjust'. I also messaged the class coordinator but received nothing. Humiliating a nine-year-old is not discipline. I request a meeting with you this week and a written assurance that this will not happen again. Otherwise I will go to the education department and consider changing schools. Sincerely, Deepa Menon

subject: Construction noise, no notice given
body: Dear management, the renovation work in the flat above mine at Meadow Lane Court has been starting at 7 am and going on till late evening for two weeks, drilling right through my work calls. No notice was given to residents, and when I asked the caretaker he shrugged and said its 'not his department'. Could someone from the office please look into this and reply to me?

subject: Packaging feedback
body: Order arrived fast, but the box was huge for one tea packet and full of plastic. Mildly disappointing given the PureLeaf sustainable branding. Oliver

subject: Cancelling at renewal unless things change
body: Six years as a Skyline Telecom customer and the quality of service has dropped badly since the new management took over. Each call to support takes up to 40 minutes, the agent is different every time, and I have to explain the same problem again each time. Yesterday a supervisor hung up on me mid-sentence. I am giving you until the end of the month to improve things before I move my family's three connections to a competitor. Prakash Venkatesan
